title: GHA: Update dependency awslabs/aws-lc to v5.1.0
body:
This PR contains the following updates:

| Package | Update | Change |
|---|---|---|
| [awslabs/aws-lc](https://redirect.github.com/awslabs/aws-lc) | minor | `5.0.0` → `5.1.0` |

---

### Release Notes

<details>
<summary>awslabs/aws-lc (awslabs/aws-lc)</summary>

### [`v5.1.0`](https://redirect.github.com/aws/aws-lc/releases/tag/v5.1.0)

[Compare Source](https://redirect.github.com/awslabs/aws-lc/compare/v5.0.0...v5.1.0)

##### What's Changed

- Quote LIBCRYPTO\_PATH for dynamic load test by [@​WillChilds-Klein](https://redirect.github.com/WillChilds-Klein) in [aws#3259](https://redirect.github.com/aws/aws-lc/pull/3259)
- Add SSL\_CTX\_set\_security\_callback and related APIs for OpenSSL compat… by [@​WillChilds-Klein](https://redirect.github.com/WillChilds-Klein) in [aws#3275](https://redirect.github.com/aws/aws-lc/pull/3275)
- ci: move BSD actions to scheduled by [@​dougch](https://redirect.github.com/dougch) in [aws#3276](https://redirect.github.com/aws/aws-lc/pull/3276)
- Bump cross-platform-actions/action from 0.32.0 to 1.2.0 in the github-actions group by [@​dependabot](https://redirect.github.com/dependabot)\[bot] in [aws#3285](https://redirect.github.com/aws/aws-lc/pull/3285)
- Bump the cargo-ci-lambda group in /tests/ci/lambda with 4 updates by [@​dependabot](https://redirect.github.com/dependabot)\[bot] in [aws#3284](https://redirect.github.com/aws/aws-lc/pull/3284)
- Bump aws-cdk-lib from 2.251.0 to 2.255.0 in /tests/ci in the pip-ci group by [@​dependabot](https://redirect.github.com/dependabot)\[bot] in [aws#3283](https://redirect.github.com/aws/aws-lc/pull/3283)
- ML-DSA: import and enable x86\_64 assembly backend from mldsa-native by [@​jakemas](https://redirect.github.com/jakemas) in [aws#3195](https://redirect.github.com/aws/aws-lc/pull/3195)
- ci: fix Windows CI breakage from VS2026 (MSVC 14.51) image bump by [@​justsmth](https://redirect.github.com/justsmth) in [aws#3298](https://redirect.github.com/aws/aws-lc/pull/3298)
- Fix PostgreSQL integration: match upstream revoked-cert alert regex by [@​justsmth](https://redirect.github.com/justsmth) in [aws#3299](https://redirect.github.com/aws/aws-lc/pull/3299)
- Support SSL\_OP\_IGNORE\_UNEXPECTED\_EOF option by [@​prasden](https://redirect.github.com/prasden) in [aws#3294](https://redirect.github.com/aws/aws-lc/pull/3294)
- Update MySQL CI integration to mysql-cluster-9.7.1 by [@​justsmth](https://redirect.github.com/justsmth) in [aws#3302](https://redirect.github.com/aws/aws-lc/pull/3302)
- Switch integration tests to nightly and raise alarm on failures by [@​prasden](https://redirect.github.com/prasden) in [aws#3287](https://redirect.github.com/aws/aws-lc/pull/3287)
- Stabilize libgit2 integration test by [@​justsmth](https://redirect.github.com/justsmth) in [aws#3300](https://redirect.github.com/aws/aws-lc/pull/3300)
- Fix SSL\_CTX\_add\_extra\_chain\_cert slot routing for chains added before the leaf by [@​samuel40791765](https://redirect.github.com/samuel40791765) in [aws#3296](https://redirect.github.com/aws/aws-lc/pull/3296)
- Make OPENSSL\_memcmp constant time by [@​WillChilds-Klein](https://redirect.github.com/WillChilds-Klein) in [aws#3183](https://redirect.github.com/aws/aws-lc/pull/3183)
- Add WASIp2 build and test support by [@​justsmth](https://redirect.github.com/justsmth) in [aws#3172](https://redirect.github.com/aws/aws-lc/pull/3172)
- Move TLS 1.3 KDF into the FIPS module and wire up ACVP by [@​justsmth](https://redirect.github.com/justsmth) in [aws#3247](https://redirect.github.com/aws/aws-lc/pull/3247)
- Bump the github-actions group across 1 directory with 4 updates by [@​dependabot](https://redirect.github.com/dependabot)\[bot] in [aws#3307](https://redirect.github.com/aws/aws-lc/pull/3307)
- Define OPENSSL\_INIT\_NO\_ATEXIT as a no-op by [@​samuel40791765](https://redirect.github.com/samuel40791765) in [aws#3311](https://redirect.github.com/aws/aws-lc/pull/3311)
- ML-DSA: import and enable aarch64 assembly backend from mldsa-native by [@​jakemas](https://redirect.github.com/jakemas) in [aws#3219](https://redirect.github.com/aws/aws-lc/pull/3219)
- ci: opt in to allow-unsafe-pr-checkout for gated pull\_request\_target jobs by [@​jakemas](https://redirect.github.com/jakemas) in [aws#3313](https://redirect.github.com/aws/aws-lc/pull/3313)
- Bump AWSLC\_FIPS\_VERSION to 5 for next FIPS branch by [@​samuel40791765](https://redirect.github.com/samuel40791765) in [aws#3316](https://redirect.github.com/aws/aws-lc/pull/3316)
- Add 'version -fips' to surface FIPS module version in openssl tool by [@​samuel40791765](https://redirect.github.com/samuel40791765) in [aws#3315](https://redirect.github.com/aws/aws-lc/pull/3315)
- Concurrency is not generally supported for EVP\_AEAD\_CTX\_foo functions by [@​torben-hansen](https://redirect.github.com/torben-hansen) in [aws#3318](https://redirect.github.com/aws/aws-lc/pull/3318)
- Prepare v5.1.0 release by [@​samuel40791765](https://redirect.github.com/samuel40791765) in [aws#3321](https://redirect.github.com/aws/aws-lc/pull/3321)

**Full Changelog**: <https://github.com/aws/aws-lc/compare/v5.0.0...v5.1.0>

</details>
